title: Grateful Dead Live at CBS Studios in West Hollywood on 1969-01-18
lineage: audio processed in Soundforge 6.0, 48kHz, 1536kbps wav, mono) extracted to 44.1kHz, 1411kbps wav with DVD Audio Extractor> tracks cut with GoldWave> compressed to flac with EasyFlac level 5. No SBE's verified with shntool.

ai_review.summary: Good TV matrix recording captures a groovy Playboy After Dark set with standout Mountains on the Moon and a kick‑ass St. Stephen.
ai_review.review: The tape is a televised Playboy After Dark performance that delivers solid sound for its era – clear enough to enjoy the band’s interplay while retaining the ambience of the lounge.  Reviewers especially praise the “Mountains on the Moon” jam and an energetic, though slightly edited, St. Stephen, and they note the novelty of two drummers and Tom Constanten on keys.  Overall the show is viewed as a fun historical moment with decent audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight strong performances plus acceptable TV‑mix sound; only one low or neutral comment, so the combined show (70%) + recording (30%) rating is high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: TV broadcast mix – clear enough for listening with typical 1960s TV compression; no major drop‑outs or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief, lounge‑styled set that skips a few verses for TV time constraints but maintains a groovy flow; two‑drummer rhythm section and Tom Constanten’s keys add historic flavor.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Highlighted for on‑air improv (the famous ‘buck knives’ story) and his charismatic presence during the interview.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) noted on keyboards, adding a psychedelic texture.
band_member_comments.Drums: Two‑drummer setup (Bill Kreutzmann and Mickey Hart) is called out as a historic moment.
